title: UAP Task Force members confirm the egg was NHI

tellings.quote: it was also confirmed to me by ranking members of the UAP task force that that is exactly what we ran into that night, that that was NHI.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says that the egg-shaped object he flew on a recovery mission one night around 2014 was non-human intelligence, meaning something not made by people. He tells Michels that senior members of the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study unidentified flying objects, confirmed this to him. He does not name them, but he offers their word as proof that what his team carried was not human.
